_comment: Copy to the path given by ADMINS_PATH. Compose mounts ${FRAMEO_ROOT}/config read-only at
/config, so the real file is ~/frameo/config/admins.json, mode 0600.
Generate every passwordHash on the server - the password is read from stdin, never argv:
docker exec -i frameo-signalling node hash-password.js -u ion -d 'Ion' -p family-ion
peerId binds the account to a roster peer. That is what keeps canCall() authoritative: a
call started from a phone is a call FROM that peer, subject to the same symmetric
EVERY ACCOUNT NEEDS ITS OWN peerId. The server permits one live WebSocket per peer id and
closes the older socket when a second one registers the same id. Two accounts sharing a
peerId means two phones knocking each other offline in a loop, so ion and maria get
family-ion and family-maria, and both must exist in roster.json with the two frames in
their allowlist (and themselves in each frame's allowlist).
The file is re-read when its mtime changes (and on SIGHUP). Setting disabled:true drops
every live session for that account within ACCOUNTS_RELOAD_MS - that is the 'my phone was
stolen' procedure, and it needs no restart. A malformed file is refused and the previous
good copy is kept, so a typo at 03:00 cannot lock everyone out.
Minimum password length is 12 characters, enforced by hash-password.js. Recommend a
four-word passphrase: the grandparents' generation types those far more reliably on a
phone keyboard than Xk9!q, and they are stronger.
